verses.raw: And what Allāh restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allāh and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives<sup foot_note=256988>1</sup> and orphans and the needy and the [stranded] traveler<sup foot_note=256989>2</sup> - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
